propositions: A deterministic floor must block epic close when an open/in_progress bug carries a caused_by edge to the epic or any descendant, with a teaching message (fix/re-parent/dispute).

Candidate filter must identify open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first open→in_progress transition OR linked to the epic subtree with any relation in either direction, capped at 32 with overflow tracking.

A single-turn forced-choice haiku screen must classify each candidate as defect-in-deliverable (A), pre-existing/adjacent (B), or unrelated (C) using model-class config and shared cache, forwarding A-verdicts as compact evidence.
The verifier must block only defect-in-deliverable bugs lacking recorded disposition: either a supersedes/duplicates link or reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose, never close_class alone.
Screen output must conform to a registered schema with normalizing validator (mirroring overlap_verdict idiom), with failures degrading open rather than blocking.
Full screen tally including per-candidate verdicts and unevaluated-overflow count must be recorded in the completion sidecar for audit and calibration.
